# Format properties: Ribbon, waterfall and funnel charts

> **Applies to:** Creators · Developers

Every card and property the Format pane offers for the visuals on this page (Ribbon chart, Waterfall chart, Funnel), generated from the visual definitions in the code. For how to use the Format pane, see [Format a visual](../../create-reports/format-a-visual.md); for what these visuals do, see [the visual article](../../visuals/ribbon-waterfall-funnel.md).

The cards on the **General** tab that every visual shares (title, effects, header icons, tooltips, alt text) are listed once in [General tab](general-tab.md).

| Visual | PBIR type | Visual-tab cards | Properties |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ribbon chart | `ribbonChart` | 7 | 90 |
| Waterfall chart | `waterfallChart` | 7 | 77 |
| Funnel | `funnel` | 4 | 29 |
